caveats.en: Intuit says QuickBooks Desktop is built for Intel/AMD, doesn't work properly on Arm, and the 6123 error can't be fixed by an update. Intuit points Arm users to hosted desktops or QuickBooks Online.
caveats.zh-TW: Intuit 表示 QuickBooks Desktop 是為 Intel/AMD 設計，在 Arm 上無法正常運作，6123 錯誤也無法靠更新修正。Intuit 建議 Arm 使用者改用代管桌面或 QuickBooks Online。

evidence.title: Intuit: Error 6123 on ARM computers, QuickBooks Desktop not compatible
